name: DepthFM
plain: DepthFM (CompVis, LMU Munich): relative depth from one image by flow matching on a Stable Diffusion UNet, in two steps. MIT code; OpenRAIL weights (commercially usable with use restrictions).
summary: DepthFM (Gui et al. 2024): affine-invariant monocular depth by flow matching from the image latent to the depth latent; a Stable Diffusion 2.1 UNet fine-tuned to the flow, a few Euler steps, ensemble of noise samples (v1).

papers.title: DepthFM: Fast Monocular Depth Estimation with Flow Matching

licence_notes: The UNet is fine-tuned from Stable Diffusion 2.1 (OpenRAIL++-M) and runs with the Stable Diffusion 1.5 VAE (OpenRAIL-M): commercial use is allowed but with use restrictions that must be passed on; the training data terms are not checked.
limitations: Flow model on a noised latent: the seeded noise comes from a CPU generator and differs from the original code's device generator for the same seed.
A traced or exported module reuses the noise of its traced shape.
The network input sides are rounded to multiples of 64, so the aspect ratio changes slightly.
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: a depth or inverse-depth map. `kind` (a card field, `result.kind`) says what the numbers mean: `metric` = metres; `scale_invariant`, `affine_invariant`, `affine_invariant_log` (log depth) and `affine_invariant_inverse` are relative (unknown scale or shift, not metres). Metric models that use the focal length take `model(image, intrinsics=K)` (K `[3, 3]`, pixels of the input): `metric3d-vit-large` and `da3metric-large` need it for correct metres (`da3metric-large`: metres = output x focal / 300; without `intrinsics=` a 300 px focal length is assumed, wrong for a real camera). `unidepth-v2-vitl14`, `unik3d-vitl`, `depth-pro` and MoGe estimate the camera themselves (given `intrinsics=` replace `fx`); `zoedepth-nk` and the relative models (`da3mono-large` too) take none. Normals-only models (`kind` `none`) return `result.normals` `[B, H, W, 3]` (unit vectors, camera frame: x right, y down, z forward).

variants.name: depthfm-v1

licence.evidence: https://github.com/CompVis/depth-fm/blob/da632c8118e41cc64ca191a13314e2db1a7722d9/README.md (fine-tuned from Stable Diffusion v2-1; code MIT); SD2 licence text from https://huggingface.co/sd2-community/stable-diffusion-2/blob/2511124fabf8bf30c0ca9dccd9729e7f0f2fa669/LICENSE-MODEL, SD1.5 VAE licence https://github.com/CompVis/stable-diffusion/blob/21f890f9da3cfbeaba8e2ac3c425ee9e998d5229/LICENSE
licence.training_note: Stable Diffusion 2.1 (LAION-5B subsets) fine-tuned on the synthetic Hypersim and Virtual KITTI 2 datasets per the DepthFM paper (arXiv 2403.13788)

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0001 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 1 % and p99 <= 3 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output `depth`).
